what: Pounds and bags of sanded, non-sanded or pre-mixed grout
title: Grout Calculator: How Much Grout Do I Need for My Tile? | Calcupine
description: Free grout calculator: pounds and bags of sanded or non-sanded grout, or gallons of pre-mixed grout, from your tile size, joint width and tile thickness.
lede: Enter your floor or wall area, tile size, joint width and tile thickness. See how many pounds of grout to mix and which bags or pails to buy.

faq.q: How much grout do I need for 100 square feet?
faq.a: For 12 by 12 inch tile, 3/8 inch thick, with 1/8 inch joints, about 7 lb of sanded grout plus 10% extra, so 8 lb. One 25 lb bag covers about 348 sq ft of that tile on Custom Building Products' chart. Smaller tiles and wider joints need much more.

faq.q: Why do small tiles need so much more grout?
faq.a: Grout fills the joints, and small tiles have many more joints per square foot. On Custom Building Products' chart, a 25 lb bag covers 96 sq ft of 2 by 2 inch mosaic with 1/8 inch joints but 348 sq ft of 12 by 12 inch tile with the same joint: more than three and a half times as much grout for the mosaic.

faq.q: Should I use sanded or non-sanded grout?
faq.a: Use sanded grout for joints 1/8 inch and wider and non-sanded grout for joints of 1/8 inch or less. Non-sanded grout is also safer on polished marble and glass tile, which sand can scratch. Check the tile maker's advice.
The full depth of the tile, down to the thinset. Scrape out any thinset that squeezes up into the joints before it sets so the grout can fill them.

faq.q: How many square feet does a 25 lb bag of grout cover?
faq.a: Anywhere from about 25 to 700 sq ft depending on tile size and joint width. Custom Building Products lists 348 sq ft for 12 by 12 inch tile with 1/8 inch joints and 54 sq ft for 1 by 1 inch mosaic with the same joint.
